definitions.explanation: Describes doing something with force, energy, or without restraint.
Mimics the sound of repeated banging or hitting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばんばん⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
ばんばん⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: To knock out work at a brisk pace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太鼓|たいこ}→太鼓：04049_taiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばんばん⟦{叩|たた}いた→叩く：02072_tataku⟧。
⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばんばん⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ばんばん⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear banging on the wall from the next room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばんばん⟦{叩|たた}いて→叩く：02072_tataku⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing by banging on the desk.

notes:
ばんばん is an onomatopoeic adverb that mimics banging sounds. Figuratively, it means doing something vigorously, without hesitation or restraint.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ばんばん⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use freely)
- ばんばん⟦{売|う}れる→売れる：02012_ureru⟧ (sell like hotcakes)
- ばんばん⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (speak without hesitation)
- ばんばん⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ (bang repeatedly)

NUANCE: More emphatic than ⟦どんどん→どんどん：01261_dondon⟧. Suggests force or enthusiasm.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どんどん→どんどん：01261_dondon⟧: One after another (neutral)
- ばんばん: Vigorously, forcefully
- ⟦じゃんじゃん→じゃんじゃん：06178_janjan⟧: Freely, without restraint
